fieldConventions.radiusKm: Physical mean/equatorial radius in kilometres; never a render-space radius.
fieldConventions.semiMajorAxis: AU for heliocentric bodies and km for moons; see semiMajorAxisUnit on each record.
fieldConventions.rotationPeriodHours: Positive sidereal duration in hours; rotationDirection carries prograde/retrograde direction.
fieldConventions.missingOptionalFields: A missing field indicates that a stable source value was not available for the rounded display dataset; no value is fabricated.

roundingPolicy: Values are rounded for a static browser visualization. Ordering, units, and major physical relationships are retained; this is not an epoch-specific ephemeris.
